title: Refine rollout variant inspector microcopy & screenreader announceability for i18n readiness
creator: Ava Mitchell
summary: Improve the Rollout Variant Inspector so that microcopy and live announcements are concise, localized, and non-noisy for assistive technologies. This covers copy strategy for variant labels, percent/weight changes, and state transitions (enable/disable/failed) across locales including pluralization and RTL languages. Deliverables: updated copy tokens, aria/live-region pattern, and a keyboard-first prototype for validation.
acceptance_criteria: Screen reader announces variant changes with a single concise sentence (no more than 12 words) in English, Spanish, and Arabic during a weight update
Live region uses polite announcements for non-critical updates and assertive only for rollout failures; aria-live usage documented
Tab order and focus behavior for the inspector respects localization (RTL switching) and does not trap keyboard users
Microcopy tokenized and placed in i18n-ready format (no inline concatenation) and approved by localization lead
Design prototype validated with VoiceOver (macOS), NVDA (Windows), and TalkBack (Android) with test notes attached
comments: 2025-02-14 Ava Mitchell: Created ticket after accessibility audit flagged noisy aria-live announcements in previous rollout inspector prototype.
2025-02-18 Liam O'Connor: Initial prototype updated — replaced verbose 'Variant X updated from 20% to 25%' with concise 'Variant B weight increased to 25%'. Added token placeholders for i18n.
2025-02-20 Maya Chen (i18n): Reviewed microcopy tokens — noted issues with pluralization in Spanish for 'variant(s)' and suggested using ICU MessageFormat tokens instead of string concatenation.
2025-02-24 Raj Patel (Engineering): Raised implementation concern — assertive announcements can interrupt synth voices. Proposing assertive only for 'failure' states; polite for changes.
2025-02-27 Accessibility review: Prototype passes keyboard traversal tests but fails VoiceOver readback for percent sign ordering in Arabic; needs example translations for % positions.
2025-03-03 PM review (Noah Alvarez): Approved copy strategy pending final localization strings; requested a follow-up usability session with customers in LATAM region.
implementation_notes: Use a single aria-live region with aria-atomic=true and update innerText to a single, fully-formed localized sentence to avoid piecemeal announcements
Politeness level: polite for weight/traffic changes; assertive only for 'rollout failed' or 'variant disabled' events
Expose copy tokens via i18n keys: rollout.variant.update, rollout.variant.failure, rollout.variant.enabled, rollout.variant.disabled
Avoid concatenation of numeric tokens and units in code — hand off full formatted strings from i18n lib (ICU) to preserve locale ordering (e.g., % before/after number)
Ensure focusable elements receive explicit :focus styles for high contrast and that focus order matches visual order in both LTR and RTL
Add role='status' fallback for older ATs that ignore aria-live=polite in nested contexts
testing_notes: VoiceOver (macOS 12) test steps: 1) Open rollout inspector, 2) Keyboard to 'Adjust Weight' slider, 3) Change value by arrow keys, 4) Confirm single live announcement with no intermediate numbers
NVDA (Windows 11) test steps: Repeat as above; confirm percent sign placement in localized Spanish build
TalkBack (Pixel 7) test steps: Verify announcements when using touch and keyboard input; confirm no repeated announcements during quick slider drags
Localization test matrix: en-US, es-ES, es-MX, ar-SA — verify pluralization, number formatting, percent placement, and collapse of long microcopy
Performance: updating aria-live region must not cause layout thrash; use textContent updates rather than React mounting/unmounting where possible
review_feedback: PM: Keep messages short and actionable. For weight increases/decreases, omit previous value to reduce verbosity unless the user explicitly requests history.
Engineering: Prefer single DOM node updates to the live region. We'll implement a small debounce (200ms) to avoid frequent rapid-fire announcements during drags.
i18n: Provide context notes for translators for each token (example values, where the string appears, politeness), and include examples for RTL reordering
Accessibility: Use aria-label for slider handles in localized form (e.g., 'Variant B slider, 25 percent') rather than reading raw aria-valuenow
follow_up_tasks: PM to coordinate customer usability session with two LATAM customers (scheduled Q2)
Engineering to prototype debounce + single-node live-region implementation and open PR referencing this ticket
Localization lead to provide Spanish and Arabic approved strings and contextual notes
Design to run one final cross-platform AT smoke test and attach results to the Confluence doc
